note: Wheeler County TX publishes no zoning districts layer; no county GIS portal found, and Texas counties generally do not zone. The City of Shamrock publishes its zoning map only as static PDF (ShamrockTX-MAP-2024-rev3, 2024 rev3, plus a manufactured-housing zone PDF), with no ArcGIS REST, GeoJSON or shapefile. City of Wheeler site lists ordinances on eCode360 and no zoning map or GIS service was found. ArcGIS Online search found no Wheeler County or city zoning service; third-party sources (Zoneomics, Regrid parcel zoning at ~27% fill) are not official.
